name: 云雾紫舒敏温和精华液款
description: 淡紫云雾舞台风面部精华液套图，质地微距与植物成分信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: misty lilac stage backdrops #E9E1F7, clean white packshot fields #FFFFFF and deep iris purple infographic panels #6E64C8
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key from the upper left, gentle bokeh glow, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter and round marble podium discs
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with rounded capsule, ring and numbered-circle elements in one accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: upright bottle presentation, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy lilac gentle skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty lilac #E9E1F7, deep iris purple #6E64C8, clean white #FFFFFF and one soft gold accent #E3C584; cool soft studio lighting with gentle bokeh and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icon style with rounded capsule, ring and numbered-circle elements; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bottle presentation with consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规立住产品全貌
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the bottle standing upright, full product visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from the front with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered and stable, no extra whitespace needed. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传递温和舒缓的核心利益，承接主图风格
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered on a round stage
shots.lighting: soft studio key from the upper left, gentle bokeh glow, soft contact shadow
shots.background: misty lilac #E9E1F7 stage with a circular cut-out backdrop panel
shots.props: round marble podium disc, circular backdrop panel with vertical slats, one green leaf sprig behind
shots.textZone: headline upper-left plus two pill tags along the left edge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} on a dreamy lilac stage. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 hero angle with the bottle centered on a round marble podium disc, before a circular cut-out backdrop panel with thin vertical slats and a single green leaf sprig behind. Soft studio key light from the upper left, gentle bokeh, soft contact shadow. Background misty lilac #E9E1F7 with white #FFFFFF panel accents. Headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in the upper-left area and two small pill tags 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 along the left edge. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space kept in the upper-left for copy. Negative: no efficacy or repair claims, no invented percentages, no brand marks, no member badges or QR codes, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大换季干燥紧绷的日常困扰，引出产品的安抚角色
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on eye-level on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flatter and duller, right panel soft glowing
shots.textZone: headline centered above the two panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and a straight-on eye-level camera. Left panel: an abstract close-up swatch of dry, tight, flaking skin texture in muted grey-beige tones under flatter duller light, no real face shown. Right panel: {product} standing calm under a soft gentle glow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels on clean white #FFFFFF. Headline 「{selling_point_3}」 centered above the panels with a short line 「{callout_3}」 beneath it. The product occupies 40-50% per panel, no extra whitespace inside the panels. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated before-and-after skin transformation, no invented statistics, no efficacy claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入清晨护理的真实场景，营造轻盈安心的氛围
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle shadows
shots.background: matte light-stone vanity counter with pale lilac wall #F0EAF8
shots.props: a folded towel, a small ceramic tray, a few frosted glass beads, none covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} on a matte light-stone vanity counter. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, the bottle standing beside a small ceramic tray. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle natural shadows. Background pale lilac wall #F0EAF8 with a folded towel and a few frosted glass beads as props, none covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible or contradictory shadows.

shots.intent: 用瓶身质感与清透液体质地特写证明产品品质
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the bottle shoulder, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the right revealing fine matte texture
shots.whitespace: none beyond the tight macro crop
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the frosted bottle shoulder with one glistening translucent droplet resting on the glass. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Soft skimming light from the right revealing the fine matte surface texture and the clear translucent droplet. Neutral white board background #FFFFFF. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond the tight macro crop. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented ingredient claims, no duplicated droplets, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking surface.

shots.intent: 用编号步骤讲清使用流程，降低上手门槛
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: numbered rings 01 02 03, translucent bubble spheres, three white rounded info capsules
shots.textZone: three numbered capsules in the right column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of a three-step usage flow for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle at the left with three thin-line numbered rings 01 02 03 and translucent bubble spheres leading to three white rounded info capsules on the right reading 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」. Even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background deep iris purple #6E64C8. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no fabricated claims inside the capsules, no invented percentages or test data, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated bubbles, no warped rings.

shots.intent: 以结构化参数卡消除规格疑虑，数值留空待后期填充
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the bottle beside the spec cards
shots.lighting: even readable lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: rounded spec cards in soft lilac #E9E1F7 with empty value lines
shots.whitespace: clean margins around the spec cards
shots.textZone: two-column spec cards with empty value lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec screen for {product}, shown at a high 45-degree angle looking down, the bottle standing beside a two-column spec card layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even readable lighting with no dramatic shadow. Background clean white #FFFFFF with rounded spec cards in soft lilac #E9E1F7, each card carrying a short label 「{callout_7}」 and an intentionally empty value line to be composited in post. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame, clean margins left around the cards. Negative: no invented dimensions, weights, volumes, dates or percentages, no dense body text, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo, no missing value lines.

shots.intent: 以植物意象与洁净氛围降低决策风险，不加虚构背书
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product centered among floating bubbles
shots.props: translucent bubbles, one green leaf sprig behind the bottle, two empty oval ingredient tags
shots.whitespace: upper 30% kept clear for trust headline
shots.textZone: two oval tags flanking the bottle plus upper headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen of {product}, straight-on eye-level, the bottle centered among floating translucent bubbles with a green leaf sprig softly out of focus behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean high-key studio light. Background pale lilac #F0EAF8 with soft bokeh, two white #FFFFFF oval tags 「{callout_8}」 flanking the bottle as blank proof placeholders. Trust headline 「{selling_point_8}」 in the upper 30% where generous whitespace is kept. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, test data, antibacterial rates or patent numbers, no fake seals or badges, no QR codes, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以深紫夜色与鎏金氛围收口促单，引导行动
shots.camera: photographed from a low angle looking upward for a heroic stance
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light with a gentle rim and warm gold glow
shots.background: deep iris purple #6E64C8 with soft gold #E3C584 glow
shots.props: floating gold beads, one rounded CTA button placeholder
shots.whitespace: lower third reserved for headline and CTA button
shots.textZone: headline and CTA button in the lower third
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}, photographed from a low angle looking upward so the bottle stands heroic and tall. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Punchier soft studio light with a gentle rim light and a warm gold glow from floating gold beads. Background deep iris purple #6E64C8 with a soft gold #E3C584 halo. Headline 「{selling_point_9}」 and one rounded CTA button 「{callout_9}」 in the lower third, where generous whitespace is reserved. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no member badges or QR codes, no efficacy claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no distorted bottle silhouette.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：1 主图为白色磨砂瓶配金属长盖立于淡紫圆形镂空舞台与大理石圆台，标题主打面部精华液；2 紫底圆形徽章与编号卖点卡，附植物成分清单；3 淡紫三栏卡片与『是否被脸部问题困扰』痛点标题；4 白瓶斜置圆形晕染特写加三枚圆形标注；5 白底四圆徽与四格卖点卡；6 白底净化主张加蓝瓶家族泡泡场景；7 紫底三栏分层卡与金色液滴横幅；8 白瓶立于紫色飘带场景，配过滤率与纳米技术字样；9 白瓶底部特写、植物成分清单与四字圆形徽章；10 紫底产品参数表与会员角标二维码，参数字段（扭力、功率、频率）与精华液品类明显错配，属模板套用错误。品类判定：参数区品名为面部精华液、第 3 屏明示使用部位为面部，故按图改判为护肤个护/面部护理而非洗护发。已剥离：品牌与系列字标、原文案原句及全部功效与数值断言（褪红修复、抑暗减黄、祛痘、焕白、过滤率、纳米技术、成分清单、保质期等一律改为占位或空白 proof 位）、会员角标与二维码、自相矛盾的错配参数（两种说法均未采用），产品一律以 {product} 占位。
